design_diagnostics.independence_note: Thirty sequential blocks cannot establish independence; these are diagnostics, not proof.

limitations: A non-significant test does not establish equal timings or equivalence.
An application-specific equivalence margin was not supplied.
Failure-stage timings are reported separately; early parse/OAEP/key-agreement failures are not pooled as one invalid class.
No sender authentication or end-to-end network cost is measured.
planned_holm_family: All four invalid scenarios versus valid for each scheme and input size (60 planned contrasts; 60 with the five configured sizes).
randomization_mechanism: one Python random.Random shuffle per block, with an independently drawn 256-bit OS seed for each block when the root seed source is OS entropy

assumptions: Each block uses an independently shuffled complete condition list.

The recorded seed was drawn from OS entropy; explicit fixed seeds are not eligible for design-based inference. Python's finite-state PRNG is treated as approximating a uniform shuffle, not as literal equal probability over every possible permutation.
No carry-over or interference changes later timings when two labels are swapped.
randomization_test.exchangeable_labels: For each fixed scheme/size pair, valid and one invalid condition occupy two positions from a uniformly shuffled complete block; conditional on those positions and the other labels, orientation is equiprobable.
randomization_test.method: exhaustive enumeration of the paired label-swap/sign-flip reference distribution; conditional/exploratory, not unqualified exact design-based inference
randomization_test.sharp_null: Swapping the valid and invalid labels changes no outcome at either assigned position in any block.

research_question: Are there processing-time differences between valid and invalid envelope decryption?
